To get a perspective, per CoinMarket data, as of date, the total circulation of Bitcoin is 19.7 million, which leaves space for a maximum of 1.3 million Bitcoins to be offered as block rewards to miners. In the ensuing years, with the actual supply of the digital currency going up and the quantum remaining fixed at 21 million, these rewards have gone down with each halving. When Bitcoin “miners” validate and record Bitcoin transactions, they receive both a block reward from the Bitcoin network and transaction fees from the retail consumer making the transaction.
